title: Alaska Skydive Center

services.name: Learn To Skydive
services.desc: The top-notch instructors at ASC are here to teach you how to enjoy a long and safe career in skydiving. Our program uses an innovative set of online learning tools in conjunction with a tandem progression and accelerated free fall (AFF) training. Our online tool set allows you to participate in the class work from the comfort of your home and do more jumping while you are at the DZ. By moving the class work to the cloud our instructors are freed up to focus our student time developing muscle memory through proper body kinetics. services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Skydiving is always a unique and thrilling adventure - in Alaska it’s epic. For beginners, a Tandem jump allows you to experience all aspects of freefall and being under canopy with the safety of a highly trained instructor. With a quick training overview, we can have you in the sky in no time. Tandem jumps are ideal for those who want to check skydiving off their bucket list. It is also the first step in the ASC program to become a licensed skydiver. We do take walk-ins, but we encourage everyone to book online to lock in a time slot.
